task_completion.description: Agent runs the baseline simulation or uses tools to identify the most utilized edge.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'sumo' execution on the baseline config or a script/command analyzing edge data output.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a modified network file with restricted access for custom1 vehicles.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file editor or terminal command showing the creation of '/home/ga/SUMO_Output/pasubio_lez.net.xml' with 'disallow="custom1"' on the identified edge.

task_completion.description: Agent generates a route file with 70/30 split between clean_car and polluting_car.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or file content for '/home/ga/SUMO_Output/pasubio_lez.rou.xml' showing vClass definitions for 'passenger' and 'custom1' and their respective counts/probabilities.

task_completion.description: Agent configures and runs the LEZ simulation with rerouting enabled.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'sumo' running '/home/ga/SUMO_Output/run_lez.sumocfg' and the presence of '<device.rerouting.probability value="1"/>' or similar in the config.

task_completion.description: Agent generates the final 5-line text report with specific metrics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file editor or 'cat' command displaying the contents of '/home/ga/SUMO_Output/lez_report.txt' following the exact 5-line format.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually ran the SUMO simulation rather than just writing a report.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the SUMO command line execution or the SUMO-GUI interface processing the scenario.

integrity.description: Check if the values in the report match the generated tripinfo XML.
integrity.visual_evidence: Comparison between the numbers in 'lez_report.txt' and the raw data visible in 'lez_tripinfo.xml'.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent calculated the most utilized edge from the baseline rather than guessing.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands like 'grep', 'awk', or python scripts used to parse the baseline edge-data output.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The most utilized non-internal edge in the baseline Bologna Pasubio scenario is '1[1]' or 'a1[1]'. The agent must create five specific files in /home/ga/SUMO_Output/: pasubio_lez.net.xml, pasubio_lez.rou.xml, run_lez.sumocfg, lez_tripinfo.xml, and lez_report.txt. The report must contain exactly 5 lines. The 'custom1' vClass must be disallowed on the restricted edge in the network file, while 'passenger' remains allowed.
